{
  "up": [
    "Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value",
    "From activities",
    "Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id",
    "Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid",
    "Join molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno",
    "Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno",
    "Filter activities.standard_relation = '='",
    "Filter activities.pchembl_value Is Not Null",
    "Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1075115'",
    "Filter assays.assay_type = 'B'",
    "Filter target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN'",
    "Filter target_dictionary.tax_id = 9606",
    "Return assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value",
    "Sort by molecule_chembl_id, assay_chembl_id",
    "Limit 1000"
  ]
}
